topic: Phrasal verb at work: push back the meeting

script.title: "Push back" – what it really means

lines.text: Oh! Push back means move it to a later time.
Can we push the call back to Friday?
Kit's tip: push back means later. Move up means earlier.
Learn more phrasal verbs on lexkite.com
